audience: restaurants that take bookings and guest feedback in resOS

useCases.title: Check tonight's bookings and party sizes
useCases.text: List the bookings for a date range, filtered by status or party size. Open one booking to read its tables and comment thread.

useCases.title: Check open dates, times and tables for a party
useCases.text: List the dates the restaurant takes bookings. Then check the times and tables that are open for a party size.

useCases.title: Look up a guest and their booking history
useCases.text: Search the guest profiles by name, then open one for contact data, tags, notes and booking count.

useCases.title: Read the latest guest feedback
useCases.text: List guest feedback for a date range. Read the ratings for food, service, value and atmosphere, and the message.

useCases.title: Create a booking for a guest
useCases.text: Check the open times first, then create the booking. The guest gets a message only if you set the notify options to true.

useCases.title: Change, cancel or annotate a booking
useCases.text: Read the booking, then update its time or party size, or cancel it. Add an internal note that the guest does not see.
